title: Add Inbox Tab to SASE TUI
description: Add a dedicated Inbox tab (second tab, after CLs) to the SASE TUI that serves as a centralized notification center. Initially surfaces agent completion notifications. Then remove the existing agents-tab badge system as obsolete. Tab order: CLs | Inbox | Agents | AXE. Two phases: Phase 1 builds the inbox tab (purely additive), Phase 2 removes the old badge system (purely subtractive).

title: Build Inbox Tab (Purely Additive)
description:
Phase 1: Build the Inbox tab as purely additive code — existing badge system remains intact.

12 steps:
1. Notification data model + persistence (notifications.py — Notification dataclass, load/save/add/remove/mark_read, cap ~100, newest-first)
2. Update TabName type alias everywhere (~20 files: add 'inbox' to Literal)
3. Inbox widgets (InboxList extending OptionList, InboxInfoPanel extending Static, InboxDetail extending Static)
4. Tab bar — Inbox as second tab with amber styling and unread badge
5. Inbox action mixin (InboxMixin: _load_inbox, _refresh_inbox_display, _dismiss_current_notification, _mark_current_as_read, _update_inbox_badge)
6. App integration (add InboxMixin, state, 'I' keybinding, inbox view in compose(), watch_current_tab update)
7. Navigation updates (tab cycling: CLs→Inbox→Agents→Axe→CLs, scroll actions for inbox)
8. Notification generation (in _poll_agent_completions, create Notification objects for newly completed agents)
9. Event handler updates (on_inbox_list_selection_changed, on_inbox_list_width_changed, auto-refresh/countdown for inbox)
10. CSS styling (inbox-view, inbox-list-container, inbox-info-panel, inbox-list-panel, inbox-detail-container, inbox-detail-scroll)
11. Help modal + keybinding footer (INBOX_BINDINGS, update_inbox_bindings)
12. Handle current_tab switch statements (add inbox case to all files branching on current_tab)

title: Remove Old Agents Tab Badge System (Purely Subtractive)
description:
Phase 2: Remove the old agents tab badge system now that the Inbox tab handles notifications. Purely subtractive — only removes code.

6 steps:
1. Remove badge from tab bar (remove _attention_count field, set_attention_count() method, gold badge rendering in _build_content())
2. Remove viewed agents persistence (delete src/sase/ace/tui/viewed_agents.py)
3. Remove viewed agents from app (remove _viewed_agents init, load_viewed_agents import, _pending_attention_count init)
4. Simplify AgentNotificationMixin (remove _viewed_agents/_pending_attention_count attrs, remove viewed/badge logic from _poll_agent_completions, remove _update_tab_bar_emphasis/_clear_tab_bar_emphasis/_mark_current_agents_as_viewed)
5. Clean up watch_current_tab (remove _mark_current_agents_as_viewed and _clear_tab_bar_emphasis calls)
6. Clean up agent dismissal (remove _viewed_agents.discard() and save_viewed_agents() calls from _killing.py)
